candidate_laws.pre_next_le_previous_peak: C_(q-1) <= C_p for consecutive primes p<q

claim_boundary: The witnesses disprove one-gap monotone repair and the tested log-plus-four envelope. They do not disprove multi-gap, average-drift, or full-ancestry bounds.

observed_linear_envelope_candidate.producer_if_proved: Telescoping prime gaps would give C_n=O(n), hence a tempered carry and exclusion of the expanding homogeneous mode.
observed_linear_envelope_candidate.statement: For consecutive primes p<q, both C_q-C_p and the interior excess above max(C_p,C_q) are at most constant*(q-p).

mechanism_decision.surviving_scope: prime-skeleton Lipschitz, aggregate-drift, or complete-ancestry repair only

programme_target: Solve Erdős 257; this tests a disposable prime-gap producer.
